name: Parsera · Every public tender, the day it's posted.
alt: Animated infographic: Parsera, Massive and your code in a stack card. A public tenders portal, fetched via Massive, shows three notices side by side. A highlighter sweeps each notice's title, deadline and agency in turn, the three fields fly down, and a new line appears in tenders.csv; the Parsera code with proxy_settings sits below. Headline: Every public tender, the day it's posted.
